text: Digs! Digs, we have a question!
I'm awake, I'm awake. Who's that with you? I can't see very well up here. It's too bright.
I'm Sprout. I'm new. And I don't know what I am.
Moles have tiny eyes, and they see very little. Under the ground, they find their way by touch, and by smell.
I mostly live down there. Tunnels and tunnels. It's cool, and dark, and it smells wonderful. Come a little closer.
You smell like the old oak tree.
The big one at the edge of the forest?
I know its roots very well. They spread out, and out, under the whole meadow. And you smell just like them.
But that tree is so big. And I'm so small.
Every oak tree starts out as one small acorn. Even that one.
A very little one. With feet.
But I can't hop like you. And I can't dig like Digs. And trees just stand in one place. All by themselves.
